questions.question: What might happen when you mix alcohol with another drug?

options.text: Both the alcohol and drug effects may get stronger.
Nothing will happen.
Both the alcohol and drug effects may get weaker.
Only the alcohol effect may get weaker.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both the alcohol and drug effects may get stronger.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol with another drug can make both effects stronger. For example, drinking one alcoholic drink while taking a cold medicine might affect you like you had several drinks.

questions.question: Traffic signs and pavement markings:

options.text: Must always be obeyed.
Are just suggestions.
Must be followed only when there is other traffic.
Must be followed only when a police officer is present.

questions.explanation: Traffic signs, signals, and pavement markings control traffic flow and keep drivers safe. You must always obey them.

questions.question: When sharing the road with a truck, remember that trucks generally:

options.text: Need longer distances to stop than smaller vehicles.
Need less time to pass on a downhill slope than smaller vehicles.
Need a smaller turning radius than smaller vehicles.
Need less time to pass on an uphill slope than smaller vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Need longer distances to stop than smaller vehicles.
questions.explanation: Because trucks are large and heavy, they need more distance to stop than smaller vehicles do.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:

options.text: Loss of concentration.
Poor coordination.
Slower judgment.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: When driving on slick roads, you should:

options.text: Take turns more slowly than usual.
Change lanes quickly.
Speed up.
Brake hard.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take turns more slowly than usual.
questions.explanation: On slippery roads, slow down before turns and curves. Going too fast on slick roads is very dangerous, especially in turns.

questions.question: If you miss your freeway exit, you should:

options.text: Take the next exit.
Make a U-turn across the median.
Pull onto the shoulder and back up to the exit.
Flag down a police officer to escort you back.

questions.explanation: If you miss your exit, take the next one. Do not back up, stop, or make U-turns on the freeway. These actions are illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No U-turn.
No left turn.
No right turn.
No turning.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, the best thing to do is:

options.text: Drink coffee.
Open your window.
Stop driving.
Turn on the radio.

questions.explanation: Fatigue while driving is as dangerous as driving under the influence. Stop driving if you feel tired.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: Sudden weather changes mean you need to change how you drive.
Slow down when driving in rain and fog.
Watch for vehicles behind you in bad weather.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: When weather changes suddenly, adjust your driving. Slow down in rain and fog. Watch for vehicles behind you that may be going too fast for the conditions.

questions.question: If you are in a serious car crash, what should you do?

options.text: Stop.
Call the police.
Check if anyone is hurt.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Move your vehicle off the road and stop if you can. If anyone is hurt, call 911 and help them. You must report the crash to police if someone is injured, someone dies, or there is more than $1,000 in property damage.

questions.question: Before changing lanes on a highway with multiple lanes, you should:

options.text: Sound your horn.
Turn on your headlights.
Slow down.
Check your mirrors and blind spots.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Look in your rearview and side mirrors to check if anyone is passing you. Turn your head to look over your shoulder to see if anyone is in your blind spot.

questions.question: At an intersection with no signs or signals, you arrive at the same time as a vehicle to your right. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and go through the intersection.
Slow down and let the vehicle on your right go first.
Drive into the intersection and force the other vehicle to stop.
Honk and drive through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let the vehicle on your right go first.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, the vehicle on the right has the right-of-way. Wait until that vehicle passes through safely before you go.

questions.question: How should you cross a railroad track safely?

options.text: Look both ways only when the red light is flashing.
Listen and look both ways, then go if it is safe.
Cross quickly when a train is approaching.
Quickly drive under any lowering gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Listen and look both ways, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are dangerous. Look and listen for trains coming from both directions before crossing. Watch for warning signals and never cross until you know it is safe.

questions.question: When should you always use your turn signal?

options.text: When changing lanes.
When pulling into or out of a parking space.
When pulling into traffic from an alley or parking area.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, pulling into or out of a parking space, or pulling into traffic from an alley or parking area. Signals tell other drivers what you are doing and help prevent accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
A merge point is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. You may see several of these signs placed through the curve.

questions.question: When should you not pass another vehicle?

options.text: On a hill or curve.
When school bus lights are flashing.
When approaching an intersection.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Never pass on hills, curves, at intersections, or before railroad crossings. Do not pass if you cannot see oncoming traffic. Do not pass a stopped school bus with flashing red lights unless you are on the opposite side of a divided highway.

questions.question: What happens if you mix alcohol with prescription or over-the-counter medicine?

options.text: The medicine reduces how alcohol affects you.
Alcohol helps the medicine work better.
The two together can make the effects much stronger.
There is no effect since they are different.

questions.correctAnswerText: The two together can make the effects much stronger.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol with medicine can increase how much both affect you. For example, one drink with cold medicine could affect you as much as several drinks without the medicine.

questions.question: What should you do to drive safely at night?

options.text: Stay farther behind other vehicles.
Do not drive if you are tired.
Check that your headlights work properly.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: Darkness reduces what you can see. Take steps to make night driving safer for yourself and other drivers on the road.

questions.question: When stopped by police for a traffic violation or equipment check, what must you show?

options.text: Proof of insurance.
Your driver's license.
Proof of vehicle registration.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: You must have your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance in your vehicle when driving. You must show all three documents when asked by police.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on the interstate, what should you do?

options.text: Cut across traffic quickly to make your turn.
Make a U-turn to go back to the exit.
Keep driving and take the next exit.
Put your vehicle in reverse to go back.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving and take the next exit.
questions.explanation: Do not make a sudden turn at an exit you are passing. If you miss your exit, continue to the next one.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Curves ahead.
Divided highway starts.
Divided highway ends.
Bumps in the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: Mixing alcohol and drugs can:

options.text: Reduce the effects of both.
Make the effects of both stronger.
Help treat your illness.
Improve your driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make the effects of both stronger.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol and drugs makes both more powerful. Driving after drinking or using drugs is dangerous. Combining them is even more dangerous.

questions.question: In a construction zone with a flagger directing traffic, you must:

options.text: Follow the flagger's directions.
Follow what other cars do instead of the flagger.
Assume the flagger should not be there.
Follow normal traffic laws instead.

questions.explanation: Slow down and follow instructions from flaggers or signs in construction zones. Not doing so is illegal and dangerous to workers.

questions.question: You are angry after a bad day at work. Before driving home, you should:

options.text: Turn up the radio to stop thinking about it.
Drive fast on the interstate to release anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Go to a bar and drink before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait until you are calm before driving. Driving while emotional is dangerous to you and others on the road.
